partial_scenario_assessments.technical: Omitted and explicit false cases pass through real ingestion. Numeric defaults never enable a list. Explicit enablement is a per-list decision.
partial_scenario_assessments.limitation: This deliberately does not inherit an enabled flag. The condensed requirement does not determine a different boolean-inheritance policy.
partial_scenario_assessments.required: Accept explicit per-list enablement and false/omitted behavior, or specify a different inheritance rule.

partial_scenario_assessments.technical: Existing fixed-embargo zero/NULL and inherited numeric settings pass. Invalid enabled adaptive limits are rejected.
partial_scenario_assessments.limitation: Enabled adaptive window/step/cap must be positive; permitting zero is a policy change, not a missing arithmetic test.
partial_scenario_assessments.required: Accept positive-only adaptive parameters or define zero meanings before changing validation.

partial_scenario_assessments.technical: Nineteen actual ingestion cases, each replayed twice, include To/Cc/NNTP matches, ignored authors, cross-posts and opt-outs.
partial_scenario_assessments.limitation: Multiple configured matches deliberately select shared legacy handling; they do not choose the strongest adaptive policy.
partial_scenario_assessments.required: Accept cross-post legacy fallback, including one opted-out list, or choose an explicit precedence rule.

partial_scenario_assessments.technical: Paused external transport permits unrelated writes; independent-writer contention controls pass. Ordinary bounded accounting uses indexed history and bounded part validation.
partial_scenario_assessments.limitation: An indivisible canonical ownership group is quarantined in one writer transaction. Its size and writer-hold time do not have a general finite bound.
partial_scenario_assessments.required: Maintainer acceptance of this explicit exception or a designed, validated reconciliation/quarantine redesign. Existing ordinary-workload timings do not waive it.

partial_scenario_assessments.technical: Normalized author/list scope and capped frozen time delay are tested; malformed identities do not share an unknown key.
partial_scenario_assessments.limitation: From is not authenticated. Spoofing a victim address can affect that scope. Conflicting source/Message-ID ownership is fail-closed and can remain quarantined until operator repair; the time-delay cap is not a quarantine-duration cap.
partial_scenario_assessments.required: Accept the trust/quarantine tradeoff for opt-in lists or require authenticated identity/provenance and define conflict recovery. Do not claim spoof-resistant attribution.

partial_scenario_assessments.technical: Maximum supported parts, bounded indexed history, pruning and 10,000 archived owners are exercised. Replays retain frozen deduplication ownership.
partial_scenario_assessments.limitation: Permanent tombstones grow with unique revisions; indivisible quarantine groups remain unbounded. There is no fixed global storage guarantee.
partial_scenario_assessments.required: Accept retention growth/operational capacity planning, or specify safe expiration/replay-horizon semantics and redesign. Deleting tombstones to make a test pass would break replay protection.

partial_scenario_assessments.decision: Bounded validation; broader input bound unresolved

partial_scenario_assessments.limitation: This is not exhaustive MIME fuzzing or a universal allocation proof. Parsing, hashing/compression and preprocessing still do work proportional to untrusted input before the writer lock.
partial_scenario_assessments.required: Accept the recorded incremental-feature scope, or define upstream ingestion size/time budgets and run a wider parser/allocation audit before claiming the full requirement.
